promotions.module.name: Promotions
promotions.module.description: Every reduction from a price in one place: promo codes, percentage and amount offs, set prices, multi-buys and basket offers, on whatever the modules that are on sell.
promotions.abilities.promotion.manage.la: Make, limit and retire promotions and their codes
promotions.abilities.promotion.apply.lab: Give a staff discount at the till
promotions.navigation.promotions.label: Promotions
promotions.description: Codes buyers type and offers that apply on their own, on tickets and anything else sold here.
promotions.empty.title: No promotions yet
promotions.empty.description: Make a promotion to give a discount to a group, a partner or a mailing list, or to run an offer such as two for one.
promotions.empty.no-kinds: Nothing sold here can take a promotion yet. Turn on a selling module, such as Box office, first.
promotions.trigger.code: When a buyer gives a code
promotions.trigger.staff: When staff give it at the till
promotions.count-by.item: Each item it is used on
promotions.count-by.sale: Each sale it is used in
promotions.words.staff: given by staff at the till
promotions.field.name: Name
promotions.field.name-help: For staff, such as Spring mailing list.
promotions.field.label: What buyers see
promotions.field.label-help: Shown beside the price, such as Spring offer. Blank to use the name.
promotions.field.needs-reason-help: Staff say why they gave it, and the reason is kept with the sale.
promotions.field.code-help: Letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores. Spaces are left out, and buyers can type a code in any case. Give each code its own limit if it needs one.
promotions.field.code-invalid: Use only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
promotions.field.free-help: The cheapest in each group are free.
promotions.field.min-spend-help: Counted on the items below. Blank for any sale.
promotions.field.targets-basket: Counts and shares the amount over
promotions.field.add-target: Add something else it applies to
promotions.field.not-with-requirements: Not on member or proof-needing prices
promotions.field.not-with-requirements-h: Leaves alone prices that are already reduced for who the buyer is, such as member and concession tickets.
promotions.field.more: Limits, dates and where it is sold
promotions.field.max-uses-help.item: Items it can be used on. Blank for no limit.
promotions.field.max-uses-help.sale: Sales it can be used in. Blank for no limit.
promotions.field.per-sale-help: Blank for every item in the sale.
promotions.field.combines-help: Applies on top of another promotion that also combines. Otherwise only the one that saves most applies.
promotions.field.note-help: For staff only, such as who the codes were given to.
promotions.field.schedule-help: Leave empty to run whenever its dates allow. A time that ends before it starts runs past midnight. Times are the theatre's.
promotions.field.schedule-times-needed: Give a start and an end time.
